_comment: Validation-tier wave list, and the ONLY place the composition lives — waves.loft holds no copy of it (@M090). `waves` is the list's LENGTH and each wave's all-regular count; `parts` REPLACES what a named wave is made of, exactly as .keys's `compose` verb does. A wave with no part is its count in regulars. Class names come from passable.loft::enemy_class_of - an unknown one is refused, never defaulted. WHY THE MIX IS regular+builder ONLY: the siege front is the wall's WIDTH, so a fixed number of robots chew at once and a wave is decided by the WORST class holding a slot. Measured (@M090): all-regular and all-builder both fall the gate base at 452 ticks; all-scout 671, all-miner 752, all-harvester never. Scouts (2.5 hex/s) arrive first and do 0.1 wall damage against a regular's 1.0, so they take slots and dilute - adding them as EXTRA bodies is worse still (12 regulars fall it at 452, the same 12 plus 4 scouts at 641). Builder is the one class tied with regular on both axes (1.5 hex/s, and damage at the front is saturated so its 1.5x buys nothing and costs nothing), so regular+builder is the only mix that cannot soften the list. A richer mix needs the class RATES changed, which is balance and deferred to the economy (ROADMAP.md item 10).
